title: Owner Auto Policy Conditions — Cancellation at the Named Insured's Request
content:
**Signed request.** A cancellation request confirmed by the named insured's signature must be on file for the Owner Auto Policy term. This is read from the company's record of the cancellation request for that term.
- A request whose status is received or withdrawn does not cancel the term.
- Only a request confirmed by the insured does.

**Effective date.**
- The cancellation never takes effect earlier than the date the request was received. This is read from the request's received date and requested effective date.
- The cancellation takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the requested effective date, when that date is on or after the date the request was received.
- Otherwise it takes effect on the date the request was received.
- Cancellations are never backdated, including when replacement insurance started earlier.

**Pending cancellation.** A term in pending cancellation may also be cancelled at the insured's request when the requested date is earlier than the cancellation effective date on the notice. The earlier date governs, and the cancellation reason is insured request.

**Retired clause.** The clause "The return premium is the pro rata unearned premium from the cancellation effective date reduced by the package's retention percentage of that unearned amount (short rate); fully earned fees are not returned" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the premium returned on a cancellation at the insured's request.

| Request received | Requested effective date | Cancellation takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| the 5th (hypothetical) | the 20th | the 20th |
| the 5th | the 1st | the 5th (never backdated) |
| the 5th | the 5th | the 5th |

superseded_clauses: The return premium is the pro rata unearned premium from the cancellation effective date reduced by the package's retention_pct of that unearned amount (short rate); fully earned fees are not returned.
